items.name: chart.ts
items.snippet: export const buildLineChartPoints = (values: number[]) => { if (values.length === 0) { return ""; } const maxValue = Math.max(1, ...values); const step = values.length === 1 ? 0 : 100 / (values.length - 1); return values .map((value, index) => { const x = index * step; const y = 40 - (value / maxValue) * 30; return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`; }) .join(" "); };
